top_signals.title: 73 Injured as Houthis Attack Four Saudi Cities
top_signals.summary: Yemen's Tehran-backed Houthis attacked four cities in the south of U.S. ally Saudi Arabia on Tuesday, wounding more than 70 people and setting oil installations ablaze in what appeared to be a major expansion of the six-month-old Middle East war.The Houthis…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Treasury Buybacks Won't Fix US Yields, Strategist Says
top_signals.summary: Lombard Odier Senior Macro Strategist Homin Lee argues that expanded Treasury buybacks won't solve underlying US yield pressures driven by large deficits. While the plan may offer short-term relief, he emphasizes that broader macroeconomic factors will continue to dictate yields. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
